title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, REST API, and static web UI. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio using natural language queries.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec) and FastAPI for the REST API. The web frontend is static HTML/JS served from S3/CloudFront. AWS Lambda functions handle OAuth and logging. GitHub Actions automate weekly reindexing.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repos, and serve the web UI or use the CLI. Deploy to AWS S3/CloudFront for production use. Integrate with AI agents via the MCP server.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and star count
Auto-generated capability clusters and related repo suggestions
CLI, REST API, and static web UI interfaces
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions

sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant WebUI
    participant FastAPIServer
    participant SQLiteVec

    User->>WebUI: Enter search query
    WebUI->>FastAPIServer: GET /search?q=query
    FastAPIServer->>SQLiteVec: Query embeddings and TF-IDF
    SQLiteVec-->>FastAPIServer: Return matching repos
    FastAPIServer-->>WebUI: Return search results
    User->>WebUI: Click repo detail
    WebUI->>FastAPIServer: GET /repo/slug
    FastAPIServer->>SQLiteVec: Fetch repo details
    SQLiteVec-->>FastAPIServer: Return repo data
    FastAPIServer-->>WebUI: Return repo details

    IndexingPipeline->>GitHubAPI: Fetch repos and READMEs
    GitHubAPI-->>IndexingPipeline: Return repo data
    IndexingPipeline->>SQLiteVec: Update embeddings and index
